discussion_comments.comment_body: Half right, and the fix is the other half. The `null` is deliberate: an explicit `undefined` is swallowed by the parameter default, so the unlisted-model case would silently get the effort options instead of none. The bug was that my edit to widen the signature to `| null` did not apply, leaving the annotation saying `| undefined` while the body already normalised `null`. Signature corrected rather than the call site.

Fair catch. Before this PR a `metadata: null` clear was encoded as `{}` and the daemon wiped the record; my rewrite sent a literal `null`, which `asPlainRecord` decodes as omitted, so the clear became a no-op. No desktop or CLI caller passes `metadata: null` over the hub today, but it was a semantic change this diff introduced, so restored the `{}` encoding in 3e428e6dc and added a test for it.
